## 中文原文
今天午休，我打算去楼下咖啡店买一杯拿铁。排队的时候，我偶遇很久没见的前同事。我们站在一旁聊了一会近况，聊得太投入，等我反应过来，午休时间快要结束。我匆匆点单，拿着咖啡快步赶回办公室。

## My translation
During today's lunch break, I decided to buy a cup of latte at the coffee shop donwstairs.
When I was waiting in the line, I came across a former colleague that I hadn't seen for a long time.
We chatted about our recent life there.
We were so absorbed that before I knew it, the lunch break was about to an end.
So I took an order in a hurry, and headed to the office with my coffee.

## Revised version
During today's lunch break, I decided to buy a cup of latte at the coffee shop downstairs.
While waiting in line, I came across a former colleague who I hadn't seen for a long time.
We stood ther chatting about what had been going on in our lives recently.
We were so absorbed that before I knew it, the lunch break was coming to an end.
So I placed my order in a hurry and headed back to the office with my coffee.

## Key phrases
- waiting in line，固定搭配没有the
- coming to an end，was about to 接动词原形
- place an order，下单
